item.title: Trump's 'roaring' economy meets a rough start to 2026: What the latest numbers show
item.description: President Donald Trump promised that 2026 would be a bumper year for economic growth, but instead it has kicked off with job losses, rising gasoline prices and more uncertainty about America's future.

item.title: Decades after violence in Selma spurred the Voting Rights Act, organizers worry about its fate
item.description: The March 7, 1965, violence that became known as Bloody Sunday shocked the nation and helped spur passage of the landmark legislation that dismantled barriers to voting for Black Americans in the Jim Crow South.
